component.name: Tile
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.label = m.top.findNode("label") end sub
sub onContent() content = m.top.itemContent m.label.text = content.title if content.hasField("tileColor") then m.bg.color = content.tileColor end sub
sub onFocus() m.bg.opacity = 0.55 + 0.45 * m.top.focusPercent end sub
